interpretation:
Scope and identity. Two complete reused reports — A = a711e11944748af5b81bf1796359f9e612329573429d6fddfb3577548158bcc9 (reach/settling report: 8 facts, 8 counterevidence, 12-item unknown/check lists) and B = 0b029cbf696005a745429dab46593f1a265b4bc35a1a4fc4819a3726420b2215 (timing/integrity report: 12 facts, 5 counterevidence, 5 unknowns, 4 checks) — plus their material audits: c6c1059bc60471b58c481380f7ccef866503a9570eb61ae34cd8989429e8caef (coding_agent.material_audit@1.0.0; formal_valid true; unqualified_adoption false; final_principal_disposition 'pending'; original_report_unchanged true) and f25788124eed8ee3aa45a8391ca4786f6c0d150b05fe6d1f92ae0adcf539c7ab (formal_validity 'pass'; material_correctness 'fail_for_unqualified_entire_report'; source_factual_result_unchanged true). Both reports inspect the same two originals, which I read directly: source S1 = 6903669a345e76c1dd2958ada4d067bfde06d02f102ce017db06c9a241c7dd51 (result_type free_reach; execution_id 494deb38d6374deb8f741e96f2430826; candidate proposal-build; configuration 803e8fb2cda1fa2035f18c2051cb2cb83c4dabf26b13f9391c2a49e1cc1b4f5c) and source S2 = d8b39c99b5595562aa7e7fec23a3f8767cd724537e8988da0ffefbc6bf7abb27 (research.metric_view@1.0.0; same candidate and execution; definition_identity c17a89e1…). Audit B's exact_source_bindings and historical_vs_current record that 'All scientific numbers here belong to historical Stage336, not this activity or the unexecuted fixed C design.' These are historical Stage 3.36 observations bound to that archived execution; they describe neither the promoted candidate nor future C. No delegation, dispositions or scientific execution was used.

Agreements (supported observations). (1) Official reach failed: S2 /official/recorded_result false, sourced from /task_success on evaluation artifact bbfd79bb55c2ad4683740663f1ec921d8f9a9784c70fb902c0e30bf2f36b3339; S2 /reach (criterion_version evaluate.reach@1.0.0, unit m, threshold 0.01, time_window_s [0.35,0.35], sources /metrics/0 and /effective/task/evaluator) records recorded_result false with value equal to the terminal distance; S1 agrees (task_accepted false, terminal_error_m equal to that same value, valid_complete_execution true, terminal_tip_speed_m_s recorded, error_convention 'actual_tip minus target', target_position_m / terminal_position_m / signed_position_error_m present). The official definition confines the criterion to complete sampled execution plus terminal distance and states component failure must never be inferred solely from overall failure. (2) Sampled holding failed: S1 /sampled_settling available true, passed false, max_error_m above position_limit_m and max_speed_m_s above speed_limit_m_s, window_s 0.05, continuous_time_guarantee false; S2 /holding/position and /holding/speed carry the same values with criterion_version controller.gvs_nmpc@6.0.0/sampled_settling, time_window_s [0.3,0.35], recorded_result null, independent_recomputation 'available', missing_material [], recomputed_result false, and motion_source 8f1a4230282a9e52ada126f075eabc64317c39c287786c05ffadc5ca547d55aa; S2 /holding/recorded_available true and /holding/recorded_window_result false. (3) Valid complete execution without solver/force faults: S1 complete true, evaluation_validity 'valid', solver_error_count 0, force_bound_violation_n 0.0, valid_complete_execution true, tendon applied tensions recorded within their limits, 35 accepted/selected initialization plans and zero converged updates; S2 /integrity mirrors evaluation_validity 'valid', execution_complete true, zero force_bound_violation_n, zero solver_error_count. (4) Recomputation is actually available and actually failed: the request-level archived_recomputation_presentation lists /reach, /holding/position and /holding/speed as availability 'available', assessment 'fail', archived_result false, official_result_preserved true, with the rule that an available Boolean false is a failed criterion and not absence of recomputation; the recomputations draw on archived motion samples rather than a new backend solve. (5) Timing: S1 control_period_s 0.01 s, control_updates 35, simulated_duration_s ≈0.35 s, deadline_misses 35 (equal to control_updates — every update late), mean_complete_update_s ≈18.35 s, measured_computation_s ≈645.83 s, real_time_demonstrated false. (6) Prediction versus acceptance: S1 one_step_prediction_summary (evidence 6195a874…) has aligned_count 35, world frame, small mean/maximum tip differences, missing []; its own scope note limits it to accepted first-step predictions matched to the next execution timestamp with no future-plan replay comparison, and S2 /limitations states one-step prediction agreement is neither reach nor holding acceptance.

Conflicts and erroneous interpretations to exclude. (a) Report B /counterevidence/2/statement asserts recomputation was 'not performed' because recomputed_result=false; audit B defect 0 (implementation tools/research_metric_view.py:57, original_source_pointer /holding/position/recomputed_result) rules the stored Boolean a failed recomputed threshold result, not a performed flag. (b) Report B /interpretation extends availability/recomputed_result to /official, which contains only recorded_result, source and definition (audit B defect 1); /official therefore carries no recomputation fields. (c) Report B /unknowns/3 and report A /unknowns/0 both treat whether recomputation happened, or the meaning of an available recomputed false, as unresolved; audit B defect 2 and audit A defect 0 reject this — the archived available result and the metric-view construction identify an actually recomputed false result, and this must not be adopted as uncertainty about whether the known criteria failed. (d) Report A /proposed_next_checks/4 seeks separate recorded holding component Booleans; audit A defect 1 calls that unnecessary and asks that recorded versus recomputed labels remain explicit. Net effect of the two audits: the available recomputed false values are known failed criteria; distinct recorded and recomputed labels should be preserved; and both reports must not be adopted unqualified (audit A unqualified_adoption false, disposition pending; audit B material_correctness fail_for_unqualified_entire_report).

Unknown causes and implications. Both holding component criteria lack a recorded pass/fail value (recorded_result null), so the holding outcome is supported only by /holding/recorded_window_result false and S1 /sampled_settling passed false; audit A makes clear this gap does not license further searches for separate recorded Booleans. No continuous-time guarantee is recorded, so whether the sampled window captures worst-case behaviour is unestablished. No explicit matching repeat or replication of execution 494deb38 appears in the supplied scope, so stability is unestablished. No per-update timing series or defined deadline criterion/budget is present — only aggregate mean/total timing and the miss count — so the deadline shortfall cannot be quantified beyond the recorded counts relative to the nominal control period. The physical cause of the recorded reach/holding shortfall is not established by these sources (audit B: no dominant physical cause or real-robot claim is established); the failure is recorded as timing/settling behaviour within a valid, complete execution, not as a solver or force fault. The underlying artifacts referenced by the sources (evaluation bbfd79bb…, detail ae9c754b…, motion source 8f1a4230…, configuration 803e8fb2…, simulation 558e0a1e…, prediction evidence 6195a874…) were not read and remain outside this scope. Whether the same execution would pass under any other evaluator or criterion version is not determinable, since only evaluate.reach@1.0.0 and controller.gvs_nmpc@6.0.0/sampled_settling are recorded.
